channel.title: RealHunt: new homes
channel.description: New homes on RealHunt, checked by a person and scored from 70 to 98.

item.title: €115,000 · Furnished lake-view house in the old centre of San Siro, Lake Como
item.description: San Siro, Lake Como, Lombardy. 85 m². RealHunt score 91. An 85 m² restored, habitable semi-detached house in the car-free historic centre of San Siro, on the west shore of Lake Como. Two floors plus a mezzanine: entrance hall, bedroom and shower room downstairs; a bright living room with fireplace and wooden beams and a separate kitchen upstairs; an attic bedroom with two Velux windows. Lake views from the living floor and the mezzanine. Sold fully furnished, with a separate cellar. Asking €115,000, about €1,353/m².

item.title: €290,000 · Spacious five-bedroom apartment in the heart of Vejer de la Frontera
item.description: Vejer de la Frontera. 191 m². RealHunt score 81. This 178 m² apartment offers five bedrooms and two bathrooms in Vejer de la Frontera, one of Andalusia's most sought-after coastal villages. The home features bright, well-maintained interiors with clean white walls, arched doorways, wooden furnishings, and a rooftop terrace with decorative tilework. The location in the town center provides access to local amenities and the charming character of this whitewashed Andalusian village.

item.title: €290,000 · Spacious five-bedroom apartment in the heart of Vejer de la Frontera
item.description: Vejer de la Frontera. 191 m². RealHunt score 82. This 178 m² apartment offers five bedrooms and two bathrooms in Vejer de la Frontera, one of Andalusia's most sought-after coastal towns. The home features bright, well-maintained interiors with arched doorways, wooden furnishings, and a terrace with countryside views. The property is in good condition and priced 24% below the area median.

item.title: €348,000 · Bright duplex apartment with exposed brick in central Madrid
item.description: Embajadores-Lavapiés, Madrid. 71 m². RealHunt score 72. Two-bedroom duplex in the vibrant Embajadores-Lavapiés neighbourhood, just 0.9 km from the city centre. Split-level design with high ceilings, industrial steel beams, and authentic exposed brick walls throughout. Original character well-preserved with modern finishes; ground floor placement provides direct street access.

item.title: €255,000 · Renovated two-bedroom flat with modern finishes in Embajadores-Lavapiés, Madrid
item.description: Embajadores-Lavapiés, Madrid. 50 m². RealHunt score 71. Recently renovated with bright, well-lit spaces and clean modern finishes throughout. Features an open-plan living-dining area and a separate kitchen. Located in the central Embajadores-Lavapiés neighborhood just 1.1 km from Madrid's city center.

item.title: €188,000 · Renovated four-bedroom house with terrace in Palmete, Seville
item.description: Palmete, Sevilla. 130 m². RealHunt score 80. Recently reformed chalet ready to move into immediately. Spacious 130 m² distributed over two floors with four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Bright living areas with large windows and a well-maintained modern interior throughout.

item.title: €199,000 · Bright renovated three-bedroom flat with modern kitchen in Bellavista, Sevilla
item.description: Bellavista, Sevilla. 100 m². RealHunt score 80. Fully renovated in 2025 with excellent natural light throughout. Open-plan modern kitchen with fitted appliances and patterned backsplash. Three spacious bedrooms plus one bathroom in a second-floor interior/exterior unit.

item.title: €197,000 · Bright four-bedroom apartment with community pool in Palmete, Sevilla
item.description: Palmete, Sevilla. 105 m². RealHunt score 83. This sixth-floor apartment offers abundant natural light and spacious interiors with a balanced layout across 105 m². It includes four bedrooms, two bathrooms, air conditioning, a garage, and storage room in a well-maintained residential building with a community pool. The contemporary furnishings and terrazzo flooring create a clean, modern aesthetic.

item.title: €134,400 · Updated first-floor two-bedroom condo near the beach in Maybury Mansions, Fort Lauderdale
item.description: Maybury Mansions, Fort Lauderdale, Florida. 81 m². RealHunt score 86. Renovated with modern finishes, light-filled spaces, and private outdoor access on the first floor. Located minutes from the beach, downtown Fort Lauderdale, and Las Olas dining. Owner-occupied community with stable occupancy supports conventional financing. Flexible possession available.

item.title: €279,600 · Mid-century ranch with open floor plan and mature oaks in Herchel Heights, Tampa
item.description: Herchel Heights Rev, Tampa, Florida. 177 m². RealHunt score 87. Charming 1958 ranch home with recently renovated interior featuring soaring ceilings, exposed wood ceiling details, and wood-look tile flooring. Open floor plan with seamless indoor-outdoor flow to a fully fenced backyard with patio. Close to parks, the Hillsborough River, and major highways for easy Tampa commuting.

item.title: €237,400 · Dual-unit investment property with rental income in Belmont Heights, Tampa
item.description: Belmont Heights, Tampa, Florida. 158 m². RealHunt score 87. The main residence features recent major upgrades including a 2021 roof, 2020 HVAC system, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and updated electrical and plumbing. The detached 1-bedroom apartment generates $900 monthly rental income with separate living spaces. The property offers multiple entrances, ample parking, and a rear deck, combining flexibility for owner-occupancy or pure investment.

item.title: €291,200 · Spacious two-story four-bedroom house with split floor plan in Buffalo Estates, Tampa
item.description: Buffalo Estates, Tampa, Florida. 210 m². RealHunt score 88. Recently updated with new roof (Jan 2022), fresh exterior and interior paint (May/April 2025), and new carpet (Feb 2026). No flood insurance required and no HOA or CDD fees. Corner lot with flexible split floor plan suited for multi-generational living, with separate entrance potential for guest suite on first floor.

item.title: €259,800 · Corner three-bed condo with three balconies in Downtown Hollywood
item.description: Hollywood Station, Downtown Hollywood, Broward County, Florida. 141 m². RealHunt score 87. A corner 3-bed, 2-bath condo of 1,522 sq ft in a 2007 building, with three balconies facing the sunsets, two parking spaces, a walk-in closet, washer and dryer, updated floors and a new fridge. The building has a heated pool, hot tub, gym, a 24-hour attended lobby and valet parking. Walk to Hollywood Boulevard, ArtsPark at Young Circle and the shops; the beach is about 2 miles away. Asking US$290,000.

item.title: €255,400 · Two-bed condo with a split plan over the gardens of Las Vistas, Doral
item.description: Las Vistas at Doral, Doral, Miami-Dade County, Florida. 96 m². RealHunt score 82. A 2-bed, 2-bath condo of 1,036 sq ft with a split floor plan for privacy, a washer and dryer and a balcony over the gardens and pool. One assigned parking space plus a guest space. Residents have a pool, gym and tennis courts, in the heart of Doral near shops, restaurants and the main highways. Asking US$285,000.

item.title: €223,100 · Top-floor two-bed condo in a gated resort-style community in Doral
item.description: Las Vistas at Doral, Doral, Miami-Dade County, Florida. 111 m². RealHunt score 87. An updated 2-bed, 2-bath top-floor condo of 1,197 sq ft in the gated Las Vistas community, with a private balcony, an in-unit washer and dryer and plenty of light. Palm-lined gardens, a large pool and a gym; close to CityPlace Doral, parks, schools and the Palmetto Expressway, about 20 minutes from Miami Airport and Brickell. Asking US$249,000.

item.title: €237,400 · Corner lakefront townhouse with a tropical garden in Westview, Pembroke Pines
item.description: Westview, Pembroke Pines, Broward County, Florida. 97 m². RealHunt score 86. A 2-bed, 1.5-bath corner townhouse of 1,040 sq ft with extra green space, a lush front garden, impact windows throughout, a newer A/C and a covered back porch with direct access to the water. Owner-occupied and well kept, in flood zone X. Clubhouse, fitness center and pool, between Pines Boulevard and Sheridan Street, minutes from I-75 and the Turnpike. Asking US$264,999.

item.title: €241,900 · Townhouse with a screened patio three blocks from Young Circle, Hollywood
item.description: Downtown Hollywood, Broward County, Florida. 121 m². RealHunt score 86. A 2-bed, 2.5-bath townhouse of 1,300 sq ft with a screened patio, an in-unit washer and dryer, a community pool and one assigned parking space. The HOA covers water and roof repairs. Three blocks from Young Circle and about 3 miles from Hollywood Beach. No leasing allowed, so the neighbours are owners. Asking US$270,000.

item.title: €266,600 · Townhouse with vaulted wood ceilings and two primary suites in Plantation
item.description: Jacaranda, Plantation, Broward County, Florida. 96 m². RealHunt score 79. A 2-bed, 2-bath townhouse of 1,030 sq ft with two primary suites and remodeled bathrooms, an upgraded kitchen, vaulted wood ceilings, a skylight, a stone accent wall and a loft. In the heart of Plantation, minutes from Plantation Walk, with quick access to the Turnpike, I-595 and Fort Lauderdale airport. Asking US$297,500.

item.title: €219,500 · Remodeled lakefront townhouse with impact windows in Pembroke Pines
item.description: Westview, Pembroke Pines, Broward County, Florida. 97 m². RealHunt score 84. A fully remodeled 2-bed, 2-bath townhouse of 1,040 sq ft with porcelain floors, wood stairs, impact glass windows and sliding doors (better storm protection and lower insurance), a new A/C and washer-dryer from 2021, and a back porch looking straight over the lake. Clubhouse, gym, pool and tennis court; close to Pembroke Lakes Mall. Asking US$245,000.

item.title: €250,900 · Bright corner split-level condo with 2.5 baths at Paragon, Plantation
item.description: Paragon at Plantation, Plantation, Broward County, Florida. 122 m². RealHunt score 85. A corner 2-bed, 2.5-bath condo of 1,316 sq ft laid out on split levels so it feels like a townhouse, with an updated kitchen and bathrooms, modern finishes, light on three sides and a private screened balcony. A well kept 1996 community with a pool and clubhouse, close to shops, restaurants and the main highways. Asking US$280,000.

item.title: €255,400 · Three-bed lake-view townhouse with a private patio in Miramar
item.description: Woodscape, Miramar, Broward County, Florida. 97 m². RealHunt score 85. A 3-bed, 2-bath townhouse with panoramic lake views, freshly painted and move-in ready, with central A/C, an in-unit washer and dryer, a fireplace and a private back patio over the water. Two bedrooms are downstairs and one upstairs. Two assigned parking spaces, and a low HOA. Asking US$285,000.

item.title: €267,900 · Guard-gated lakeside condo with an oversized balcony at the Atriums, Kendall
item.description: Atriums at Snapper Creek, Kendall, Miami-Dade County, Florida. 124 m². RealHunt score 84. A 2-bed, 2-bath condo of 1,330 sq ft with a split-bedroom plan, large closets, tile floors, an in-unit washer and dryer, elevator access, extra storage and an oversized private balcony. The guard-gated community sits on a lake among tropical gardens. The monthly fee includes cable TV, high-speed internet, water and building insurance. Asking US$299,000.

item.title: €439,000 · Corner-lot family house with a big fenced garden of fruit trees, Country Park, Boca Raton
item.description: Country Park, Boca Raton, Palm Beach County, Florida. 102 m². RealHunt score 82. A detached 3-bed, 2-bath house on a corner lot with a large fenced back garden full of fruit trees, a living room with high vaulted ceilings and crown molding, tile floors and a kitchen refreshed with quartz worktops. Hurricane impact windows, A/C from 2018 and a Ring camera. The garage is now an extra room with the washer and dryer and can go back to a garage. Community pool, tennis, basketball and lakeside paths, with a low HOA. Asking US$490,000 (about €439,000), 1,103 sq ft (102 m²).

item.title: €412,200 · Updated corner house with impact windows in Greenbriar at Boca Chase (55+ community)
item.description: Boca Chase, Boca Raton, Palm Beach County, Florida. 147 m². RealHunt score 85. 55+ community: at least one resident must be 55 or older. A detached 3-bed, 2-bath house on a premium corner lot, with full impact windows and doors, a newer roof, vaulted ceilings, remodeled bathrooms, a granite kitchen, California closets, a screened patio, a fenced garden and a hurricane-rated garage door. The community has pickleball, tennis, a pool, spa and clubhouse, and residents get a Boca Raton beach permit. Asking US$459,999 (about €412,200), 1,580 sq ft (147 m²).

item.title: €389,800 · Renovated house with a two-car garage and a 2024 roof in Greenbriar (55+ community), Boca Raton
item.description: Boca Chase, Boca Raton, Palm Beach County, Florida. 158 m². RealHunt score 86. 55+ community: at least one resident must be 55 or older. A renovated detached house with 3 bedrooms plus a room that can be a 4th, a two-car garage, a big kitchen open to the dining and family room, a primary suite with walk-in closet and shower, and a screened patio over park-like gardens. Roof and garage door 2024, water heater 2021; the A/C dates from 2014. Walk to the clubhouse, pool, tennis, pickleball and a Publix plaza. The community pool is being repaired. Asking US$435,000 (about €389,800), 1,697 sq ft (158 m²).

item.title: €447,600 · Lakefront three-bedroom house with a screened patio in Country Park, Boca Raton
item.description: Country Park, Boca Raton, Palm Beach County, Florida. 150 m². RealHunt score 83. A detached 3-bed, 2-bath house on a landscaped lot backing onto the lake, with a family room that opens to a roofed, screened patio over the water, a split-bedroom plan, vaulted ceilings, an eat-in kitchen with newer appliances, impact windows and doors, a circular drive and a fenced garden. The garage was turned into an air-conditioned room and can be turned back. A/C and water heater replaced in 2020. Country Park has a pool, tennis, pickleball and walking trails round five lakes. Asking US$499,500 (about €447,600), 1,610 sq ft (150 m²).

item.title: €246,400 · Updated 1,605 sq ft corner flat on Lake Maule with a wraparound balcony
item.description: Aventura, Miami-Dade, Florida. 149 m². RealHunt score 84. A large updated two-bedroom, two-bath corner flat with wood floors, a modern white kitchen with a breakfast bar, a bright living and dining room and two balconies, one wrapping around the living room. It sits on Lake Maule in a building with a marina, pools and tennis, near Aventura Mall and the new Brightline station. Asking US$275,000 (about €246,400), 1,605 sq ft (149 m²).

item.title: €237,400 · Golf course and skyline views from a two-bedroom at Coronado, Aventura
item.description: Aventura, Miami-Dade, Florida. 106 m². RealHunt score 82. A well-kept 1,138 sq ft two-bedroom, two-bath condo on the 23rd floor of Coronado, looking over the golf course and the Aventura skyline, with a living room, covered parking and resort-style amenities with 24-hour security. Move-in ready and a few minutes from Aventura Mall. Asking US$265,000 (about €237,400), 1,138 sq ft (106 m²).

item.title: €232,100 · High-floor two-bedroom with city views at Commodore Plaza, Aventura
item.description: Aventura, Miami-Dade, Florida. 100 m². RealHunt score 83. A move-in-ready two-bedroom, two-bath flat high up in Commodore Plaza, with a separate living and dining room, a balcony with panoramic city views and a primary suite with a big walk-in closet. The guard-gated building has two pools, a gym, sauna, tennis courts and a marina dock, with cable and water included; Aventura Mall and the Brightline station are close. Asking US$259,000 (about €232,100), 1,073 sq ft (100 m²).

item.title: €313,600 · Renovated high-floor two-bedroom with skyline and sunset views in Aventura
item.description: Aventura, Miami-Dade, Florida. 149 m². RealHunt score 83. A renovated 1,605 sq ft two-bedroom, two-bath flat high up, with skyline and sunset views, a living and dining room and modern finishes, in a building with a private marina, two pools, tennis, a gym, sauna and a courtesy bus around Aventura. It is let until September, so it suits a buyer who can wait or wants the rent. Asking US$350,000 (about €313,600), 1,605 sq ft (149 m²).

item.title: €264,300 · Sunset-view two-bedroom at waterfront Commodore Plaza, Aventura
item.description: Aventura, Miami-Dade, Florida. 118 m². RealHunt score 83. A 1,268 sq ft two-bedroom, two-bath flat with a separate living room and a private balcony facing the sunset and the city, in Commodore Plaza, a gated waterfront community with a pool by the water, tennis courts and a gym. Minutes from Aventura Mall, restaurants and the beach. Asking US$295,000 (about €264,300), 1,268 sq ft (118 m²).

item.title: €267,900 · Two-bedroom with a screened balcony over the fairways at Coronado Tower II
item.description: Aventura, Miami-Dade, Florida. 122 m². RealHunt score 81. A 1,313 sq ft two-bedroom, two-bath flat at Coronado Tower II with a screened balcony over the golf course and the skyline, wide sliding doors into the living and dining room, tile floors, a white kitchen and a walk-in closet. Gated building with a pool, gym and 24-hour security. Asking US$299,000 (about €267,900), 1,313 sq ft (122 m²).

item.title: €233,000 · Waterfront two-bedroom plus den with two balconies at El Prado, Aventura
item.description: Aventura, Miami-Dade, Florida. 145 m². RealHunt score 82. A 1,565 sq ft two-bedroom flat with a den that works as an office, an open kitchen, a living room and two balconies, in a full-service waterfront building with two pools, a marina, tennis, a gym and 24-hour gated security. The HOA covers water, Wi-Fi, cable and a repair contract for the air conditioning, plumbing and electrics. Asking US$260,000 (about €233,000), 1,565 sq ft (145 m²).

item.title: €178,000 · Penthouse in Puerto Naos with a sun terrace bigger than the flat
item.description: Puerto Naos, Los Llanos de Aridane, La Palma. 29 m². RealHunt score 91. A modern top-floor flat of 29 m² (27 m² usable) in Puerto Naos, on the sunny west coast of La Palma (Canary Islands), with a private sun terrace of about 29 m² looking over the rooftops to the Atlantic. Living room with an integrated kitchen, one bedroom with fitted wardrobes and a bathroom, all opening onto the terrace with loungers and a dining table. In good condition and furnished; the promenade, beach, restaurants and shops are a short walk away and La Palma airport is about 45 minutes by car. Third floor, no lift. Asking €178,000; buyer pays a 3% agency fee plus 7% IGIC.

item.title: €29,000 · Holiday flat with a big sea-view terrace and garden in Calabria
item.description: Torremezzo, Falconara Albanese, Calabria. 55 m². RealHunt score 91. A 47 m² ground-floor flat in the Residence Solemar at Torremezzo di Falconara Albanese, on the Tyrrhenian coast of Calabria. Bright living room with kitchenette opening straight onto a large tiled terrace with bougainvillea and a wide view over the sea, plus a bedroom and a bathroom. Good condition. Asking €29,000.

item.title: €30,000 · Furnished seaside flat a few steps from the beach at Acqualadrone, Messina
item.description: Acqualadrone, Messina, Sicily. 40 m². RealHunt score 91. A 40 m² flat on the first floor of a 1985 building at Acqualadrone, on the northern tip of Sicily near Messina, with the sea right across the road. Living room with kitchenette, a bedroom, a bathroom and a terrace looking over the Tyrrhenian. Sold fully furnished and ready to move in. Asking €30,000.

item.title: €30,000 · Village house with a sea-view balcony in Pollina, 30 minutes from Cefalù
item.description: Pollina, Palermo, Sicily. 50 m². RealHunt score 91. A 50 m² terraced village house with 2 rooms and 2 bathrooms in Pollina, one of the prettiest hill villages of northern Sicily, in the Madonie park. Balcony and rooftops with a sweeping view down to the sea and the coast towards Cefalù; the nearest beach is about 15 minutes away. Good condition, sold privately. Asking €30,000.

item.title: €28,000 · Furnished beachfront studio 50 m from a sandy beach in Calabria
item.description: Falerna Marina, Calabria. 40 m². RealHunt score 91. A 40 m² studio on the 6th floor (with lift) of a seafront building at Falerna Marina, Calabria, 50 m from a long sandy beach with beach clubs. Sea-facing, sleeps up to 4, sold with fridge-freezer and washing machine. About 15 minutes from Lamezia Terme international airport. Asking €28,000.

item.title: €22,000 · Four-level village house with sea and mountain views in Sangineto, Calabria
item.description: Sangineto, Cosenza, Calabria. 108 m². RealHunt score 91. A 108 m² house over four levels in the old village of Sangineto, on the Riviera dei Cedri in Calabria, with views over the rooftops to the sea and the mountains. Living room with a modern kitchen, a wood-clad bedroom with period tiled floor and balcony, an attic with a second kitchen, two bathrooms and a storage room. Good condition. Asking €22,000.

item.title: €11,380 · Furnished log cabin on stilts with a deck in the Hida forest
item.description: Shokawa, Takayama, Gifu. 53 m². RealHunt score 91. A 1999 log cabin of 53 m² on a 332 m² freehold plot in a managed forest estate in Shokawa, Takayama. Open living room under a loft, log-walled kitchen and bathroom, and a wooden deck in the trees. Sold furnished with appliances, water included in the estate fee of about ¥11,000 a month. Asking ¥2 million, about €11,400.
